description: On the countertop in front, there’s a small open cardboard box near the back and several bright cleaning cloths (yellow, pink, blue, and green) spread out closer to you. The left hand repeatedly reaches forward to pick up individual cloths, then swings up and toward the box to toss them in or onto it—first moving the yellow cloth aside, then lifting and throwing the blue cloth into the box, followed by grabbing and tossing the pink cloth toward the box, and finally gathering and moving the remaining yellow and green cloths; the right hand is not involved.
